name: railway_variable_upsert
description: SET or UPDATE one environment variable (variableUpsert). Requires `projectId`, `environmentId`, `name`, and `value`. Optional `serviceId` (omit to set a shared/environment-level variable rather than a service-specific one) and `skipDeploys` (true to set the value without triggering a redeploy; default false, which redeploys affected services so the change takes effect). Returns a boolean. This changes live configuration and may trigger a redeploy — confirm the variable name, target service/environment, and intent before calling; do not print the secret value back to the user.

serviceId.description: Optional service id (from railway_get_project). Omit to set a shared environment variable.

skipDeploys.description: If true, save the variable without triggering a redeploy. Default false.
